title: Stockfish 16 Native Main-Search and Quiescence TT Early-Return Microinterventions, No-Op Equivalence, Depth-Conditioned Root Pair Flip, and Search-Path Interaction

execution.builds: separately compiled unmodified and counter-instrumented sf_16; equivalent source and net before patch
execution.tt_scope: Guard early TT-value return at main search and qsearch independently; TT probes, TT move ordering, TT-value evaluation, and TT writes remain functional. Not a full TT knockout.

preexisting_worlds.provider: Lichess broadcast; same provider, previously examined in C3X
preexisting_worlds.negative_control: standard chess initial board; artificial, not source game

instrumented_separate_subposition_panel.result_definition: Masked_output_changed_cells compares complete UCI semantics including nodes and PV, NOT bestmove flip counts.
instrumented_separate_subposition_panel.warning: Counts add recurrent deep-search events across both depths, both cold repeats and multiple source-related boards; not independent events or games.
instrumented_separate_subposition_panel.interpretation: Combined intervention can restore the previous root choice despite either individual intervention redirecting it. This reflects nonadditive adaptive search-path feedback, not an identified single causal TT event.

direct_root_multiPV_pair.design: MultiPV=2, go depth D searchmoves f3f4 g3g4; same exact root and legal restricted candidate set in each cold engine process; both depth 8 and 12 twice.
direct_root_multiPV_pair.inference: Source-level family knockout of MAIN early TT returns can flip a previously frozen marginal root pair at completed depth8, reproducibly. At depth12 the preference does not flip. Effects are depth-conditional and change search paths and nodes; not an individual event necessary/sufficient certificate.

claim_ceiling: G9.5-P13/14/15 prior search-event causality/transport mechanisms remain ancestral, not rediscovered or superseded by coarse TT cutoff family knockout.
CECLUB and TCEC are previously observed Lichess games, not new independent holdouts or separate provider ecology.
SF16 native TT cutoff mask is not a general chess concept nor a complete TT shutdown.
Search path and node counts change when an early cutoff is disabled; scores are compared under equal named depth, NOT equal computation/TT state.
CP are within Stockfish only; finite search output is not minimax or objective chess truth.
Depth8 local root pair switch is not a depth12 or other-engine replicated mechanism.
No passed-pawn causal mediation, human educational effectiveness, or authorized C3X causal explanation certificate.
next_target: Prospectively identify individual TT cutoff events along candidate roots, test sham and one-event necessity/sufficiency with adversarial and null controls; jointly test independent engine and source when viable; connect to Explain as bounded search observation until full certificate.
github_committer_contract: All GitHub commits by authenticated WhoSia; Actions contents:read and never writes repository refs.
